gemma4_gloss.en: Holy Franciscan Friar!
Brother, hello!

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
This same should be the voice of Friar John.
Welcome from Mantua. What says Romeo?
Or, if his mind be writ, give me his letter.

gemma4_gloss.en: This should be the voice of Friar John.
Welcome from Mantua.
What does Romeo say?
Or, if he has written his thoughts, give me his letter.

speaker: FRIAR JOHN
raw:
Going to find a barefoot brother out,
One of our order, to associate me,
Here in this city visiting the sick,
And finding him, the searchers of the town,
Suspecting that we both were in a house
Where the infectious pestilence did reign,
Seal’d up the doors, and would not let us forth,
So that my speed to Mantua there was stay’d.

gemma4_gloss.en: I went to find a barefoot brother.
He was one of our order.
He was here in this city visiting the sick.
The town officials found us.
They suspected that we were both in a house.
A deadly disease was there.
They locked the doors and would not let us out.
Therefore, my trip to Mantua was stopped.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw: Who bare my letter then to Romeo?

gemma4_gloss.en: Who will carry my letter to Romeo?

speaker: FRIAR JOHN
raw:
I could not send it,—here it is again,—
Nor get a messenger to bring it thee,
So fearful were they of infection.

gemma4_gloss.en: I could not send it.
Here it is now.
I could not find a messenger to bring it to you.
They were very afraid of the infection.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
Unhappy fortune! By my brotherhood,
The letter was not nice, but full of charge,
Of dear import, and the neglecting it
May do much danger. Friar John, go hence,
Get me an iron crow and bring it straight
Unto my cell.

gemma4_gloss.en: Unfortunate luck!
By my brotherhood, the letter was not simple.
It was full of important instructions.
Ignoring it may cause much danger.
Friar John, go away from here.
Get me an iron crow.
Bring it straight to my cell.

speaker: FRIAR JOHN
raw: Brother, I’ll go and bring it thee.

gemma4_gloss.en: Brother, I will go and bring it to you.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
Now must I to the monument alone.
Within this three hours will fair Juliet wake.
She will beshrew me much that Romeo
Hath had no notice of these accidents;
But I will write again to Mantua,
And keep her at my cell till Romeo come.
Poor living corse, clos’d in a dead man’s tomb.

gemma4_gloss.en: Now I must go to the monument alone.
Juliet will wake in three hours.
She will scold me because Romeo did not know about these events.
But I will write to Mantua again.
I will keep her in my cell until Romeo comes.
Poor living body, trapped in a dead man's tomb.
